setup: Same broad existing replica of 25 demo branches before and after. Run 0 is first query after reopening the app, not an empty disk cache. Runs 1 and 2 repeat within that session. WebKit may share origin OPFS across temporary profiles; no origin data was cleared between these measurements.
timing: Application search start through data readiness; excludes painting. Small sample, not a general benchmark or percentile claim. Baseline includes temporary per-storage-command diagnostic instrumentation; final deployed build has none.
